Design an alternative way to investigate aggression which uses the case study method and

text: Bandura et al. conducted a laboratory study to investigate aggression in children. An alternative
way to collect data would be to conduct a case study.

Section B (20 marks)
Answer one question from this section.

text: Freud (little Hans) conducted a longitudinal case study to investigate the Oedipus complex.

parts.text:
Outline what is meant by the ‘social approach’ in psychology. 
Using the studies from the list below, answer the questions which follow:
Haney, Banks and Zimbardo (prison simulation)
Milgram (obedience)
Piliavin et al. (subway Samaritans)

parts.label: (b)
parts.text: Describe the environment in which each of these studies was conducted.

parts.label: (c)
parts.text: What problems may psychologists have when they investigate social processes?
